howto: Pick Cadet (ages 5–7), Pilot (7–9) or Master (9–11), then a leg: Arithmetic, Ballast Trim, Instrument Check, Signal Repair, Scrambled Beacon or the Long Haul.
Read the question on the paper card at the top.
Steer your ship through the ring with the right answer; a wrong ring costs a hull point and shows the answer with a teaching hint.
In word legs, fly through the letters in order, or type the whole word.
Reach the end of the leg before the hull gives out; three hull points left earns three marks.
tips: HINT teaches the step for the ring in front of you: make a ten, count up on a number line, skip-count, or the next sound of the word.
Every three right answers in a row raises your multiplier; every five earns a free kit item.
CLEAR removes all but one wrong ring; DRIFT slows time; PATCH mends one hull point.
Every four answers the questions step up inside your age band.
The end card lists every miss with its answer and hint: read it before the next leg.

controls.keyboard: Mouse or arrows steer; 1, 2, 3 use Drift, Clear, Patch; type letters to spell the whole word; H shows a hint in number legs; M toggles sound; Esc, Space (between rings) or P pauses.
controls.touch: Drag to steer; tap DRIFT, CLEAR, PATCH and HINT under the ship; TYPE WORD opens the keyboard in word legs.

difficulty: Three age bands: Cadet (ages 5–7), Pilot (7–9) and Master (9–11). Each band has its own range of question tiers and every four answers steps up inside it: from adding within 20 up to fractions and percentages, and from short words up to tricky words.

settings.quality: Hangar > Graphics: High / Low (Low renders at 1× pixels without the paper-grain pass; the choice is remembered)

features.age-or-level-bands: Cadet · ages 5–7 / Pilot · 7–9 / Master · 9–11 in the hangar; the tier ramps inside the band
features.hints: HINT in the kit (H, or the arcade Hint) writes a teaching nudge on the question card; a wrong ring shows the answer with its hint
features.grown-up-progress-report: For Grown-ups in the hangar (all time) and on the end card (this leg): skills practised, accuracy, words to practise and what to practise next
features.tutorial: How to Fly coach on the first leg (steer, fly through the right ring, hint and kit); skip it or replay it from the hangar
features.results: End card with marks, log, answers, longest run, accuracy, distance, the missed-question review and the grown-up report
